about: Synthetic evaluation set for comparing lexical, semantic and hybrid retrieval (Phase 09). Every document was written for this file; none is copied from a real organization. It is small on purpose: it guards against regressions and documents how the modes differ on this set; it does not measure real-world accuracy. With the mock embedding provider, 'semantic' means hashed words and character trigrams: typos and shared word pieces help it, true synonyms and paraphrases do not.

documents.text:
# Employee handbook

This handbook explains how we work at Acme. It applies to every employee on a permanent or fixed-term contract.

## Annual leave

Every employee receives 25 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave is requested in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead. Unused days may be carried into the first quarter of the next year.

## Expenses

Expense receipts must be submitted within 30 days of purchase. Meals while travelling are capped at 40 euros per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed.

## Remote work

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in the employee's time zone, and the team calendar shows where everyone works.

## Equipment

Laptops are refreshed every three years. Broken equipment is replaced by the IT desk, usually within two working days. Personal devices may not store customer data.

## Conduct

We treat colleagues, customers and partners with respect. Concerns can be raised with a manager or anonymously through the ethics line.

# IT security policy

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must never be shared with anyone, including IT staff.

Multi-factor authentication is required for VPN access and for the email system.

Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the security team within 24 hours.

Suspicious emails are forwarded to the phishing mailbox and then deleted.

# Archived rule (2018)

Until 2019 the old rule asked for passwords of 8 characters, changed every 90 days. This archived rule was withdrawn and no longer applies.

# Travel policy

Flights are booked at least fourteen days before departure through the travel desk.

Hotel nights are capped at 120 euros, or 180 euros in capital cities.

Trains are preferred over flights for journeys shorter than four hours.

# Office

The office opens at 8:00 and closes at 17:00 on weekdays. Visitors sign in at the reception desk.

# Office update

From January 2026 the office opens at 9:00 and closes at 18:00 on weekdays.

# Onboarding

Accounts are created by IT before the first day. New starters meet their buddy on the first morning, and the welcome lunch is on Friday of the first week.

Product FAQ

Customers can export their data in CSV and JSON formats from the settings page.

Deleting an account removes all of its data within 30 days.

The public API allows 100 requests per minute for each API key.

Executives receive 35 days of annual leave and a laptop refreshed every year. Passwords for the payroll system are 20 characters.
